text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (...I lost. Trainer... I'm sorry.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...... ...Yeah, I've got to head back.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: —Pheww...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(I wonder what's the matter with 
Zephyr-san...?)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(...Ah, could it be...? Did they start 
feeling sick!?)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Um, Zephyr-san...! Are you all right?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...To the wind.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"I could not... become the wind. My 
physical body... is still bound here."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: The weight is still right here... ugh.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"If I can't even reach them here, then 
what lies beyond is out of the 
question...!"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(No, she's not sick. Zephyr-san is... just 
really frustrated.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(What... should I do? I want to cheer them 
up, but... is it okay for me to say 
anything...?)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry. I ended up taking it out on 
you, didn't I?"

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. Your thoughtfulness 
calmed my troubled heart a little.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh? No way, I haven't done anything...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Will our next race together be the 
Takamatsunomiya Kinen?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I drifted along rather feebly today. 
However, next time, I will yield to no 
one.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Zephyr-san...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm really frustrated too. Next time, 
let's both run a race we won't regret...!
